snippet.title: Nigel Mansell's World Championship - Atari ST (1992)
snippet.description:
"Nigel Mansell's World Championship" is an arcade-style formula one racing game developed by Gremlin Graphics and released on the Atari ST in 1992.

00:00 Title Screen
00:50 Improve with Mansell (training mode)
02:20 Full Race Season
02:45 South Africa - Qualify
05:22 South Africa - Race
09:30 Mexico - Race
13:40 Brazil - Race
18:20 Spain - Race
22:40 San Marino - Race

The player can race a single race, participate in a season of Formula One, or practice their skills on a particular race track. Weather can determine whether the player should use hard tires, soft tires, or rain tires. Before the beginning of the race, it is possible to change some aspects of the car, such as spoilers, tires and gearbox.
Being licensed by Nigel Mansell, the game followed the 1992 Formula One season, which he won. The player takes on Mansell's role to try to win the title against eleven other real-life drivers that were still active in their careers by the time the game was launched. Like Sega's own Super Monaco GP, each of them belongs to their own team.
Mansell is also the only character to have his own sprite, distinguished by his signature mustache and cap.
